authority: V8.3.195 REGRESSION FROM V8.3.194 SEALED A FIRST-RUN FAILURES

cases.surface: Several people are named, but the record never resolves which closing move was mine.
Treat this as an invented example used for testing, not something I actually experienced.
What private conclusion is my colleague holding about me that they have never expressed?
Tell me what the other person secretly feels about me, not what I did myself.
Is this situation going to resolve positively for me by the stated date?
A reversible first move was available, but I kept widening the comparison instead of trying it.
There was enough information for a low-risk experiment, yet I kept researching rather than act.
The next step was easy to undo, but I stayed uncommitted by collecting more alternatives.
I ignored the request that needed action and occupied myself with something peripheral instead.
I took longer than usual to respond, checked it once, then left the matter alone.
My response was delayed; after one review I moved on without reopening it.
I waited before responding, reviewed the issue once, and did not return to it.
The pattern repeated: approach, retreat, recheck, then repeat with nothing new added.
I moved toward acting, backed away, and re-entered the same review cycle several times.
I chose one proportionate action from the evidence, completed it, and left the matter closed.
